Class CardRow

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.model.board.CardRow
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CardRow extends Object implements Serializable
A fixed-size row of cards on the game board, split into two logical regions:
  • Indices 0 .. numTribeCards-1 — tribe cards (characters and events).
  • Indices numTribeCards .. size-1 — building cards.
Null slots represent empty positions.
